title: Hello World (real model)
summary: Sends your message to a real model (Gemini, through Firebase AI Logic) and shows the reply. No API key in the code.
learn: Calling a hosted model from a web page: model name, instructions, one message, one reply
Why the API key never goes in browser code, and how Firebase AI Logic + App Check protect it
Handling slow replies and errors (quota, permissions, network) like a real product
